subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB1068
title: Directs the State Board of Parole and Post-Prison Supervision to classify a sex offender who has previously been placed into a risk level in another jurisdiction into the corresponding risk level in this state.

claims.text: SB 1068 was introduced in the Senate on February 20, 2025.
